name: Lysander Ainsworth
source:
Lysander is a student attending Sweet Amoris High School. He is first introduced as a band member with Castiel, whom he is best friends with. Lysander lives with his brother, Leigh. The two of them are rather close, and they both wear the same unique clothing style.
He's mysterious and isn't very talkative, which doesn't make him easy to get to know.

Likes: music, rabbits, reading
Dislikes: lies, judgmental behavior
